agent_checkpoints_state_check.name: agent_checkpoints_state_check
agent_checkpoints_state_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("agent_checkpoints"."state") = 'object'
        and "agent_checkpoints"."state"->>'version' = '1'
        and "agent_checkpoints"."state"->>'userId' = "agent_checkpoints"."user_id"::text
        and "agent_checkpoints"."state"->>'conversationId' = "agent_checkpoints"."conversation_id"::text
        and "agent_checkpoints"."state"->>'runId' = "agent_checkpoints"."run_id"::text
        and pg_column_size("agent_checkpoints"."state") <= 524288

agent_clarifications_answer_check.name: agent_clarifications_answer_check
agent_clarifications_answer_check.value:
("agent_clarifications"."status" = 'pending' and "agent_clarifications"."answer" is null and "agent_clarifications"."answer_message_id" is null and "agent_clarifications"."answered_at" is null)
        or ("agent_clarifications"."status" = 'answered' and char_length(btrim("agent_clarifications"."answer")) between 1 and 2000
          and "agent_clarifications"."answer_message_id" is not null and "agent_clarifications"."answered_at" is not null)

agent_runs_terminal_timestamp_check.name: agent_runs_terminal_timestamp_check
agent_runs_terminal_timestamp_check.value:
("agent_runs"."status" = 'completed' and "agent_runs"."completed_at" is not null)
        or ("agent_runs"."status" = 'cancelled' and "agent_runs"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("agent_runs"."status" in ('queued', 'running', 'waiting_for_user', 'failed'))

messages_content_parts_check.name: messages_content_parts_check
messages_content_parts_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("messages"."content_parts") = 'object'
        and "messages"."content_parts"->>'version' = '1'
        and jsonb_typeof("messages"."content_parts"->'parts') = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("messages"."content_parts"->'parts') between 1 and 16

messages_finalized_at_check.name: messages_finalized_at_check
messages_finalized_at_check.value:
("messages"."status" = 'streaming' and "messages"."finalized_at" is null)
        or ("messages"."status" in ('final', 'failed') and "messages"."finalized_at" is not null)

conversations_active_dataset_check.name: conversations_active_dataset_check
conversations_active_dataset_check.value:
("conversations"."active_dataset_id" is null and "conversations"."active_dataset_version_id" is null)
        or ("conversations"."active_dataset_id" is not null and "conversations"."active_dataset_version_id" is not null)

dataset_versions_counts_check.name: dataset_versions_counts_check
dataset_versions_counts_check.value:
("dataset_versions"."row_count" is null or "dataset_versions"."row_count" >= 0)
        and ("dataset_versions"."column_count" is null or "dataset_versions"."column_count" > 0)
        and ("dataset_versions"."profile_version" is null or "dataset_versions"."profile_version" > 0)
        and "dataset_versions"."ingestion_attempt" >= 0

dataset_versions_claim_check.name: dataset_versions_claim_check
dataset_versions_claim_check.value:
("dataset_versions"."ingestion_claim_id" is null and "dataset_versions"."ingestion_claimed_at" is null)
        or ("dataset_versions"."ingestion_claim_id" is not null and "dataset_versions"."ingestion_claimed_at" is not null)
